title: SAGE information not uploaded to Nightscout (miaomiao2)
symptom: SAGE information from xDrip is not uploaded to Nightscout, possibly limited to miaomiao2 + FSL. The Nightscout website is up to date and xDrip version is Pre-release d7689af-2019.11.02.
cause: Apparently there's no 'Sensor Start' or 'Sensor Change' treatment record. The user is supposed to 'Start Sensor' once from xDrip (select 'not today' for whichever reason), then 'Change' the sensors. xDrip will set the time to somewhere in the past though, off by one day.
fix: If you know how to work with the NS API, you may add a 'Sensor Start' treatment record to the database (entryType, date, created_at, and possibly notes with the sensor code should be sufficient), NS will show a valid SAGE afterwards.
evidence_quote: Apparently there's no "Sensor Start" or "Sensor Change" treatment record - I think you're supposed to "Start Sensor" once from xDrip (select "not today" for whichever reason), then "Change" the sensors. (xDrip will set the time to somewhere in the past though, off by one day.)
